latin: Ens de suis passionibus et ultimis differentiis quiditatiue non praedicatur.
translation: Being is not predicated quidditatively of its own attributes and ultimate differences.
translation_note: Reflects the transcendental, wholly undetermined character Scotus assigned to the concept of being (Farmer's note, farmer1998:12275). Sense checked against farmer1998:12304.
